categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of water-based printing materials, including water-based printing adhesive pastes, water-based resins, and silk-screen silicone rubber. Additionally, the company develops, designs, and sells automated printing equipment. The company operates through multiple product categories serving the textile printing industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies including novel latex polymerization technology, moisture-retention technology, dye anti-sublimation technology, anti-sticking technology, automated integrated clean production technology, digital white adhesive paste technology, intimate apparel bonding silicone technology, polyurethane-acrylic copolymerization technology, and bio-based water-based material technology. Most technologies are at mass production stage, with bio-based water-based material technology in small-batch trial production. The company uses automated integrated production equipment combining dispersion, emulsification, thickening, vacuum defoaming, pressurization, and filtration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's products are primarily applied in the textile printing field and have been incorporated into supply chains of major global brands including Adidas, Nike, FILA, Anta, Li-Ning, C&A, GAP, Victoria's Secret, Disney, SHEIN, and Yizhi. The company serves both direct manufacturers and trading companies in the textile printing industry. End applications include apparel, footwear, special textiles, handicrafts, and water-based wood coatings.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with manufacturing facilities in Dongguan (Liaobu District) and Huizhou (Huiyang District). The company has established domestic sales networks and conducts international business, with foreign sales accounting for approximately 21% of revenue in 2024. The company exports products globally and maintains customer relationships across Asia, Europe, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the supply chain, positioned between upstream basic chemical materials (petrochemicals, titanium dioxide, resins) and downstream textile printing manufacturers and brand companies. The company transforms basic chemical materials into specialized printing materials and equipment for textile applications, serving as a critical link between raw material suppliers and textile printing processors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous technology improvement and product innovation in water-based printing materials. Strategic priorities include developing digital printing adhesive pastes and functional adhesive pastes, advancing bio-based printing materials, expanding applications in footwear and furniture sectors, deepening existing sales channels, and enhancing integrated solutions combining materials, equipment, and processes. The company emphasizes environmental sustainability and compliance with international standards including ZDHC and OEKO-TEX certification.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of water-based printing materials (adhesive pastes, resins, silicone rubber) and automated printing equipment. Revenue is recognized when control of goods transfers to customers, which occurs upon customer receipt and signature for domestic sales, or upon shipment for export sales. Equipment sales are recognized after installation and acceptance. The company operates on a buy-and-sell basis with both manufacturers and trading companies, with payment terms typically ranging from 1 to 12 months after delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: According to Frost & Sullivan data, the company ranks among the leading domestic manufacturers of water-based printing adhesive pastes, with domestic market share increasing from 10.3% in 2018 to 11.5% in 2022, ranking first in 2020 and 2022. The company competes in a fragmented industry with numerous regional competitors. The company differentiates through superior product quality, comprehensive product portfolio, integrated solutions, and strong customer relationships with major global brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized chemical materials manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 553.2 million yuan, representing 4.4% growth from 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 70.0 million yuan in 2024, down 15.1% from 2023, with net profit margin of 12.7%. Total assets reached 1.17 billion yuan at year-end 2024, up 47.2% from 2023. The company completed its initial public offering in September 2024, raising 277.2 million yuan in net proceeds. The company demonstrates steady growth with expanding asset base and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company provides comprehensive integrated solutions combining water-based printing materials, equipment, and technical expertise, enabling customers to improve production efficiency and reduce costs. Key differentiators include: proprietary core technologies with patent protection; products meeting international environmental standards (ZDHC, OEKO-TEX, REACH); comprehensive product portfolio addressing diverse printing requirements; technical support through automated printing laboratories; and established relationships with major global brands. The company emphasizes environmental sustainability, product quality, and customer service as core value propositions.
